target_customer: Companies and technical teams wanting a self-hostable automation and AI agent platform, now enterprises
problem: Business automation tools like Zapier are closed and costly at scale. Activepieces is an open source, self-hostable no-code alternative with community built integrations.
business_model: Open core: MIT community edition, paid cloud and enterprise features, usage-based per flow run

founders.name: Ashraf Samhouri
previous_startups: described as a 3x founder, names not given

founders.name: Mohammad AbuAboud
founders.background_notes: YC launch post calls him ex-Google.

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow engine, many integrations and a piece SDK are standard engineering at scale with community contributions.

defensibility.rationale: MIT license makes copying and forking easy; integrations and community contributions add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not verified; the company remains independent and active.

market_need_then: Demand for self-hosted open alternatives to Zapier; the YC launch post positioned it that way and launched with 15 apps.

identity.voice_and_tone: Open source friendly, now enterprise focused

branding.brand_signature: Pieces, the community built integration units
branding.community_and_virality: GitHub README says 60 percent of pieces are community contributed; about 270 contributors per one directory.

brand_strength.rationale: Solid open source community pull, name unexplained and similar in feel to other automation names.

pivots.why: Not stated; positioning change visible on current site

outcome_analysis: Activepieces is active and has grown from a 2022 open source Zapier alternative into an AI agent and automation workspace with named enterprise customers. Funding is documented only by aggregators and a founder interview, so the capital behind the growth is unclear. Community contributed integrations and open source distribution appear to be the main drivers.
notes: Unverified funding figures: a Feedough founder interview says 1.55M USD; CB Insights says a 0.5M convertible note on 2022-09-07 from Y Combinator, with inconsistent totals; other aggregators say 1.6M or 125K. No primary announcement found, none recorded as rounds. Customer figures are company claims. No competitor sources dated near mid 2022 were verified, so the list is empty. Pivot date not stated.
